name: Fighting Friends
overview: Scripture reveals that true friendship is marked by steadfast love and support, especially in times of adversity, as a friend loves at all times and a brother is born for adversity (Proverbs 17:17). However, the Bible also warns against those who cause division and strife, noting that a contentious person sows discord and a whisperer separates close friends (Proverbs 16:28). Wisdom is found by walking with the righteous and wise, whereas companionship with fools leads to destruction (Proverbs 13:20; 12:26). Moreover, covering a transgression fosters love, but repeating offenses breaks even the closest friendships (Proverbs 17:9). Thus, fighting among friends contradicts the biblical ideal of love, unity, and wise companionship.
